inflation.note: GASTAT CPI held at 1.7–1.8% through Jan–Aug 2026; IMF projects ~2.2% for 2026. 2% is a rounded long-run planning figure.

savings.note: SAMA repo 4.25% in 2026; 12-month SAR deposits / murabaha typically quoted around SAIBOR (~4.5–5%). No current published average deposit rate found.

balanced.note: Blend of deposits and equity; judgement.

longTerm.note: TASI price index rose ~6.6% a year from end-2016 to end-2024 (Argaam); adding ~2–3% dividends gives ~8–9% total return.

cardApr.note: Saudi card APRs vary widely (SAMA’s disclosure example 19%; one bank calculator shows 45%). No published market average found.

loanApr.note: Personal finance for salaried Saudis is commonly quoted ~3–4% flat (≈6–8% APR); expats pay more.

income.note: GASTAT 2024 puts the average Saudi worker’s wage near SAR 10,100 a month (via a secondary guide); expat pay varies widely.

extraFields.label: Dependent fee (expats)
extraFields.help: If you live in Saudi Arabia on an iqama, the government fee for each family member you sponsor (SAR 400 a month per person), usually paid for the whole year when the iqama is renewed. Enter it as a monthly amount. Leave at 0 if you are a Saudi citizen.

localTips.title: Negotiate rent when you choose how often to pay
localTips.why: Rent is usually agreed per year on Ejar and paid in 1, 2 or 4 instalments. Enter it here as the yearly amount divided by 12. Paying in fewer instalments can earn a discount.
tips: Ask the landlord what the yearly rent would be if you paid in 1 or 2 instalments.
Make sure the contract is registered on Ejar so increases follow the agreed terms.
Compare similar flats in your district on listing apps 2 months before renewal.

localTips.title: Stay under 6,000 kWh in summer months
localTips.why: Homes pay 18 halalas a kWh up to 6,000 kWh a month and 30 halalas above it, so the hottest months cost much more per unit for big villas.
tips: Check monthly kWh in the SEC app; aim to keep peak months under 6,000.
Set split units to 24°C and switch off AC in empty rooms and majlis.
Shade west-facing windows and service AC units before summer.

localTips.title: Limit buy-now-pay-later on everyday shopping
localTips.why: Splitting purchases into instalments makes it easy to spend more than planned each month.
tips: Turn off instalment options as the default payment in shopping apps.
Keep a running total of open instalment plans and their due dates.
Wait 24 hours before buying anything over SAR 500.
